statement: Foraging speed depends on the Power of each pet assigned to the area plus each pet's Genetic Bonus; stacking genetics gives the most speed.
He breaks foraging speed optimization into about 8 steps keyed to pet unlocks.
First phase: assign the Squirrel pet with the Forager genetic to every available slot in each area.
Forager genetic makes the pet contribute 2x foraging speed; its foraging power is multiplied by 2.
From the second area down you need a pet with Fight Power (red background) assigned first before foraging pets can forage.
Step two is Bored Bean with Fleeter genetic: all pets contribute 1.3x more foraging speed.
Use squirrels plus a Bean pet: about 30% more on top of Forager 2x gives 2.6x power per squirrel.
Second stage and below team: 1 Combat pet
Step three is Baby Boa with Targeter genetic: 5x foraging speed if the pet above is also a Targeter.
Third step team: 1 Combat pet
Targeters must be in a single column; moving one out of the column drops the bonus significantly.
Bored Bean multiplies after the Targeter 5x so a single Bean gives about 150% more foraging speed.
Blooming Axe upgrade lets foraging pets contribute some speed to fight power so no combat pet is needed; use 3 Targeters plus a Bean.
Opticular genetic gives 3x foraging speed if that pet has the largest number on the team.
Opticular is mainly useful in Grasslands where no row above allows Targeter bonuses; use a single Opticular pet there.
Opticular isn't useful in other lines since Targeters give 5x instead; it's only a small extra gain.
Step four is Pet Whale with Badumdum genetic: pets in territory above and below contribute 1.2x more foraging speed.
Use Whales in every row since they boost pets in every row; more significant than Bored Bean despite lower multiplier.
Whales aren't effective in first row but from second row on; use a Targeter with a Bean and 1 to 2 Whales.
You can use 2 Targeters and just 1 Whale at this stage but start collecting enough Whales for next stage.
Step five is Bunny with Flashy genetic: all pets contribute 1.5x more foraging speed if no Combat pets on the team.
With Blooming Axe no combat pets are needed; upgrading Bored Beans to Bunnies gives about 20% more team foraging speed.
Step six is Wode Board pet with Miasma genetic.
Miasma genetic: all pets in the team contribute 4x more foraging speed if there are no two pets of the same type.
Replace 1 Whale with the Wode Board so there are no duplicates; Targeter pet gets roughly 43x more power.
Ideal setup at this stage: 1 Targeter
Step seven is Bloque with Alchemic genetic: 50% chance for 2 spices when filling the reward bar.
Diminishing returns: each filled bar increases foraging needed per spice; Alchemic gains more spices in same time even with less speed.
Line 1 setup uses Opticular pet plus Bunny
Second line: a Targeter plus 3 Whales to maximize Encroaching Forest speed rather than Jungle speed.
Three Whales above and three below make speed huge; continue pattern down: Targeter
Last step is Nutto with Borger genetic: contributes 10x foraging speed if territory above has at least 1 Forager type.
Borger setup replaces Targeter columns with a Forager pet then Borger pet; keep Opticular in Grasslands since no area above.
Alternate columns from Encroaching Forest and Jungle: Forager plus 3 Whales
This is one of the best setups and gets foraging speed into the multi-millions while keeping Alchemic bonuses.
You can flip-flop Jungle and Encroaching Forest setups; putting Borger in Jungle gives more spices in the second
For Grasslands and Encroaching Forest consider swapping to more Alchemics for more spices per day if you collect only 1x or 2x a day.
If you collect more often than that keep the higher foraging speed setup; diminishing returns favor Alchemics when collecting less often.
